params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Get-Command mhw-fast -All | Select-Object Name,CommandType,Source,Definition,Path | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; where.exe mhw-fast 2>$null; Get-ChildItem -Path $env:USERPROFILE -Filter 'mhw-fast*' -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 30 FullName | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 2
